expected.source: Yun CH et al. 'The T790M mutation in EGFR kinase causes drug resistance by increasing the affinity for ATP.' PNAS 2008;105:2070-2075.

notes: T790M increases ATP affinity, not gefitinib binding directly. WT Kd estimated from L858R reference (2.4 nM) scaled to approximate WT baseline.

expected.source: Cross DA et al. 'AZD9291, an irreversible EGFR TKI, overcomes T790M-mediated resistance to EGFR inhibitors in lung cancer.' Cancer Discovery 2014;4(9):1046-1061.

notes: Osimertinib is a third-generation irreversible inhibitor designed to overcome T790M resistance. L858R/T790M IC50 ~1 nM vs L858R ~12 nM.

expected.source: Canon JR et al. 'The clinical KRAS(G12C) inhibitor AMG 510 drives anti-tumour immunity.' Nature 2019;575(7781):217-223.

notes: G12C selectivity is absolute; sotorasib shows >1000-fold selectivity for G12C vs WT KRAS. IC50 ~12 nM for G12C Ba/F3 cells; WT is non-responsive.

expected.source: Hallin J et al. 'The KRASG12C Inhibitor MRTX849 Provides Insight toward Therapeutic Susceptibility of KRAS-Mutant Cancers.' Cancer Discovery 2020;10(1):54-71.

notes: Adagrasib shows >1000-fold selectivity for G12C. Ba/F3 IC50 ~5 nM for G12C. Cellular IC50 in H2122 cells ~21 nM.

expected.source: Bollag G et al. 'Clinical efficacy of a RAF inhibitor needs broad target blockade in BRAF-mutant melanoma.' Nature 2010;467(7315):596-599.

notes: V600E confers ~16-fold selectivity over WT BRAF (32 nM WT vs 6.1 nM V600E from in vitro kinase assays).

expected.source: Shah NP et al. 'Multiple BCR-ABL kinase domain mutations confer polyclonal resistance to the tyrosine kinase inhibitor imatinib (STI571).' Cancer Cell 2002;2(2):117-125.

notes: T315I shows profound imatinib resistance; IC50 >200-fold higher than WT. Gatekeeper mutation blocks binding.

expected.source: O'Hare T et al. 'AP24534, a pan-BCR-ABL inhibitor for chronic myeloid leukemia, potently inhibits the T315I mutant and overcomes mutation-based resistance.' Cancer Cell 2009;16(5):401-412.

notes: Ponatinib designed to overcome T315I via acetylenic linker. Inhibits T315I at clinically achievable concentrations.

expected.source: Frost MJ et al. 'Juxtamembrane mutant V560GKit is more sensitive to Imatinib (STI571) compared with wild-type c-kit whereas the kinase domain mutant D816VKit is resistant.' Molecular Cancer Therapeutics 2002;1(12):1115-1124.

notes: D816V in activation loop shifts KIT to active conformation; imatinib (type II inhibitor) shows >50-fold resistance. GI50 >5 µM for D816V vs 0.1 µM WT.

expected.source: Choi YL et al. 'EML4-ALK mutations in lung cancer that confer resistance to ALK inhibitors.' NEJM 2010;363(18):1734-1739.

notes: L1196M is gatekeeper mutation; sterically blocks crizotinib. Estimated ~20-fold resistance based on clinical observations and resistance mutation prevalence.

expected.source: Quintás-Cardama A et al. 'Preclinical characterization of the selective JAK1/2 inhibitor INCB018424: therapeutic implications for the treatment of myeloproliferative neoplasms.' Blood 2010;115(15):3109-3117.

notes: Ruxolitinib inhibits JAK2 WT at 2.8 nM (enzyme assay). In Ba/F3 JAK2 V617F+ cells, IC50 ~127 nM. V617F confers ~45-fold cellular resistance.

expected.source: Choi YL et al. 'EML4-ALK mutations in lung cancer that confer resistance to ALK inhibitors.' NEJM 2010;363(18):1734-1739; modeled docking binding energies −9.7 kcal/mol WT vs −9.6 kcal/mol L1196M.

notes: Lorlatinib overcomes single L1196M mutation effectively; minimal fold-shift (~3-fold). Binding energy difference ~0.1 kcal/mol indicates comparable affinity.
